case.title: CRA-Blindfleck
case.profileText: Consumer IoT manufacturer shipping smart-home sensor devices with embedded firmware, remote over-the-air update capability and a companion mobile application. Devices maintain a permanent network connection to the vendor cloud for telemetry, diagnostics and security patching. No personal health data is processed; the company sells hardware products with digital elements in the EU.
case.notes: THE-423 regression case (ADR-0006 E6): family is FOUND, but retrieval topHits contain only enforcement/procedural provisions - the scope article exists in the corpus (typed scope-applicability) yet is never surfaced by similarity. Without the guarantee the judge never sees Art. 2 and rules 'not applicable'.

paragraphs.title: Market surveillance and control
paragraphs.text: Market surveillance authorities shall carry out appropriate checks on products with digital elements, review documentation and, where necessary, take samples for testing in laboratories.

paragraphs.title: Powers of market surveillance authorities
paragraphs.text: Market surveillance authorities may require economic operators to provide technical documentation, access to software and data, and may order corrective actions for non-compliant products.

paragraphs.title: Procedure at national level for products presenting a risk
paragraphs.text: Where a market surveillance authority finds that a product with digital elements presents a significant cybersecurity risk, it shall require the operator to take corrective action or withdraw the product.

paragraphs.title: Union safeguard procedure
paragraphs.text: Where objections are raised against a national measure, the Commission shall evaluate the measure and decide whether it is justified, addressing its decision to all Member States and the operator concerned.

paragraphs.title: Penalties
paragraphs.text: Member States shall lay down rules on penalties applicable to infringements and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are implemented; penalties must be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

paragraphs.title: Confidentiality of market surveillance information
paragraphs.text: Authorities and the Commission shall protect information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks with regard to confidentiality and professional and commercial secrecy, and safeguard trade secrets.

paragraphs.title: Scope
paragraphs.text: This Regulation applies to products with digital elements whose intended or reasonably foreseeable use includes a direct or indirect logical or physical data connection to a device or network.
